title: Payments R4: NIP-EXT G9: `fee_msat` and `payout` in plugin releases (Spark address, Lightning address, or node key)
body:
Design: [central receive and splits, sections 3 and 5](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/blob/main/docs/payments/2026-10-02-central-receive-and-splits.md#5-payout-destinations-and-payouts); API gap G9 in `docs/api/2026-10-02-openagents-api.md`.

## Do
- `nips/openagents/NIP-EXT.md`: optional release fields `fee_msat` (u64, per call) and `payout` (one of `spark1…` mainnet Spark address, `name@domain` Lightning address, or a 33-byte hex node key), signed with the release so they are pinned. Unknown shapes refused.
- `crates/nostr` EXT release types and validation, with tests for each accepted and refused shape.
- `openagents plugin publish` (or the release builder it uses) takes `--fee-sats N` and `--payout ADDRESS` and writes both. Coordinate with #10182 (publishing a plugin to the registry).

## Done when
- A release with both fields round-trips through `crates/nostr` and fails validation for a regtest `sparkrt1…` address or a malformed address.


Size: **Coder-sized** (`openagents chat work --issues coder-sized`).

Part of the central payments plan: https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/blob/main/docs/payments/2026-10-02-central-receive-and-splits.md
